decisions.title: Clause-ID prefixes for the framework areas
decisions.question: Which three-letter prefixes identify the abstract-kernel, protocols, cross-cutting-requirements, package-framework, implementation-specification and conformance areas (existing: ATA, CNS, CTR, PMT, RTM, SSOT)?
decisions.proposal: KRN, PRT, XCR, PKG, IMP, CNF

decisions.title: Naming of 'epoch' concepts
decisions.question: CORE-O-01: the release anti-rollback counter, the controller key epoch and the in-session counter all use the word 'epoch'. What are the distinct names?

decisions.title: Generated merged specs and merge tooling
decisions.question: The *-spec-full.md files are generated by scripts and workflows that still point at the old specs/core paths. Fix paths, replace, or retire? (Tooling is code and is outside this Markdown-only plan.)
decisions.proposal: Fix the paths by hand outside the plan, then regenerate

decisions.title: Licensing model
decisions.question: Licence for the specification text versus any code licence, and the commercial boundary for forks and implementers.

decisions.title: Governance and contribution model
decisions.question: Who decides changes to the framework, how changes are proposed, and the security-disclosure channel.

decisions.title: Versioning and release policy
decisions.question: Suite version scheme (e.g. OS10-AMK 2.x), VERSION file semantics, compatibility rules, COMPLIANCE_MAPPINGS_VERSION semantics.

decisions.title: Conformance model
decisions.question: What the conformance levels (the 'proof' axis) are, self-declaration versus third-party certification, and what 'a fork passes all conformance checks' means.

decisions.title: Machine-readable artefacts
decisions.question: This plan is Markdown-only. Are JSON schemas or test-vector data files ever permitted in castiel? (Non-blocking; no task depends on it.)

decisions.title: Compliance mapping scope
decisions.question: Depth of the mappings to EU AI Act, GDPR, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST AI RMF and SOC 2, which versions to pin, and the not-legal-advice stance.

decisions.title: Deferral policy for open items
decisions.question: Which open items may be deferred beyond the first release, and how a deferral is recorded.
decisions.proposal: Defer only with a recorded rationale and owner

decisions.title: Kernel operating levels
decisions.question: The set of kernel operating levels and the dimensions of the Host AI capability matrix they are derived from.
